configuration.adjacency_rule: Disjoint polygon interiors and shared boundary dimension 1; DE-9IM F***1****

notes: One local run; compare with prior desktop observation, not a controlled multi-run benchmark.
Source archive cached; all geometry adjacency rebuilt and timed in this run.
Original numerical solver unchanged; its docstrings now distinguish power cells from whole-block polygons.
Every accepted rebalance move decreases maximum deviation or, at the same maximum, squared population error.
Graph correction makes these assignments a postprocessed district plan, not an exact power diagram.

notes: Gzip sizes are measured bytes for these saved artifacts, not browser memory or latency.

Polygon component counts describe geometric fragmentation; no adjacency repair is performed by this exporter.
